description: Run a Stork-operated AI media tool and pay per call from your Stork credit balance — fully autonomous, no human. Requires header 'Authorization: Bearer sk_stork_<key>' on a key whose wallet has credits (create a key + top up at stork.ai/dashboard/settings). Returns a URL to the finished full-resolution result; you are only charged on success. Tools: upscale, photo-restore, museum-restore, cartoonize, pet-portrait, passport-photo.

imageUrl.description: Public URL of the input image to process

variant.description: Optional style variant for tools that support it (e.g. pet-portrait: renaissance, oil, military, watercolor, floral, memorial)

name: stork_run_tool
